bloc.Pour charger beaucoup de documents sans:
For uploading many documents without going through a backup. Choose a folder — its subfolders are scanned — or a selection of files. Unrecognised formats and files that are too large are excluded and listed; they do not interrupt the rest.
The subfolder name becomes the theme of the document: an EDF/ or IEC #/ folder reproduces your filing without you having to re-enter it.
bloc.Sur conseilprevcyber, ouvrez /admin/base:
On conseilprevcyber, open /admin/base-connaissance and click 💾 Sauvegarder (Save): a file conseilprevcyber-rag-backup-#-#-#.json is downloaded — the date changes every day, and the name does not matter here: only the content of the file is examined. Wait for the download to finish before dropping it — a file still being written is incomplete, and this is cause No # of failed transfers. All documents are imported with their original theme — standards areas, technical families and company names — and additionally linked to the corresponding Sentinel pages.
The transfer can be replayed: a document already present is skipped, never duplicated. You can stop it and resume it.
